description: This file defines asynchronous functions for managing seed data, user authentication, game listing, progress tracking, achievements, and syllabus mappings in a backend API related to an educational gaming platform. It interacts with SQLAlchemy models for various entities such as Game, Achievement, Progress, etc.

methods.name: None ensure_seed_data(session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: Initializes the database with seed data for games, levels, achievements, and syllabus mappings if they do not already exist.

methods.name: User create_user(session: AsyncSession, email: str, display_name: str, password: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user with hashed password and stores it in the database.

methods.name: Optional[User] authenticate_user(session: AsyncSession, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Validates user credentials by comparing provided password with stored hash.

methods.name: List[Game] list_games(session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: Retrieves all active games and their associated levels.

methods.name: Tuple[Progress,List[str]] record_result_and_update_progress( session: AsyncSession, user_id: int, game_id: int, difficulty: int, score: int, )
methods.description: Updates user's game progress based on submitted result, checks for achievements, and returns progress and earned achievement keys.

methods.name: List[Tuple[Progress,Game]] get_progress(session: AsyncSession, user_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches all progress entries for a user along with associated game info.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Achievement],List[UserAchievement]] get_achievements(session: AsyncSession, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves all achievements and those earned by a specific user.

methods.name: List[Tuple[SyllabusMapping,Game]] query_syllabus_mappings( session: AsyncSession, game_id: Optional[int] = None, subject: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Returns syllabus mappings filtered by optional game ID and subject.
